mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_link_stat ( LINK_ID, CLICK_COUNT, DAY_CLICK, WEEK_CLICK, MONTH_CLICK, LAST_CLICK_TIME ) VALUES ( #{friendLinkId}, 1, 1, 1, 1, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CLICK_COUNT = CLICK_COUNT + 1, DAY_CLICK = DAY_CLICK + 1, WEEK_CLICK = WEEK_CLICK + 1, MONTH_CLICK = MONTH_CLICK + 1, LAST_CLICK_TIME = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE friend_link_stat SET DAY_CLICK = 0 WHERE DAY_CLICK != 0
UPDATE friend_link_stat SET WEEK_CLICK = 0 WHERE WEEK_CLICK != 0
UPDATE friend_link_stat SET MONTH_CLICK = 0 WHERE MONTH_CLICK != 0
